name: TestNG QA Automation Pipeline

# Triggers this pipeline automatically whenever a Pull Request is opened or updated targeting 'main'
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch: # Allows you to manually trigger the build with a button click on GitHub

jobs:
  run-automation-suite:
    # Spins up a fresh, isolated Windows cloud virtual machine
    runs-on: windows-latest

    steps:
    # Step 1: Download your source code onto the cloud runner machine
    - name: Checkout Repository Source Code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    # Step 2: Dynamically install Java on the cloud virtual machine
    - name: Setup Java JDK Environment
      uses: actions/setup-java@v4
      with:
        java-version: '17'            # Matches your target compilation profile
        distribution: 'temurin'       # Uses Eclipse Temurin, just like your local setup
        cache: 'maven'                # Caches your dependencies so subsequent runs take seconds

    # Step 3: Execute your TestNG test cases via Maven command line
    - name: Execute Automation Tests
      run: mvn clean test

    # Step 4: Publish your test outputs right into your Pull Request window
    - name: Publish Test Reports Summary
      uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action/composite@v2
      if: always() # Ensures reports are generated even if your code throws test failures
      with:
        files: '**/target/surefire-reports/*.xml'
